results_provenance: Experimental counts and aggregate metrics manually checked by the experimenter against the completed NOTS aggregate summary.json; this does not establish independent verification of all runtime artifacts or hashes.

evaluation_protocol.inference: One library inference pass at confidence 0.05
evaluation_protocol.matching: Greedy descending-IoU assignment of eligible pairs at IoU >= 0.50; category correctness assessed after matching
evaluation_protocol.deduplication: Shared Spring boundary-aware routine; not class-aware

definitions.raw_predictions: Library-returned detections retained at each confidence threshold before cross-tile deduplication; not unfiltered logits
definitions.localized_gt: Known references matched irrespective of category
definitions.correctly_classified_gt: Known references with both correct localization and category
definitions.unmatched_predictions: Deduplicated predictions not assigned to a known reference; unreviewed, not confirmed false positives

limitations: Incomplete annotations prevent interpreting unmatched predictions as confirmed false positives or establishing full-scene precision/AP.
Threshold-dependent category correctness requires further investigation; per-threshold assignments can change.
Validation ROI-grid results do not establish whole-slide or held-out test performance.
The inherited 28-class mapping includes draft sponsor-review merges.

reproducibility.note: File names and provenance behavior verified in evaluator source. Experimental counts, aggregate metrics, checkpoint SHA256 and baseline check were manually checked by the experimenter against the completed NOTS aggregate summary.json; other runtime artifacts and hashes were not independently verified.

baseline_check.verification: Manually checked against completed NOTS aggregate summary.json; matches Bob's reported results.
